pages.title: Cannabis Seed Storage and Inventory Guide
pages.search_intent: store lawfully acquired cannabis seed with identity, temperature, moisture, access-control, opening-history, and planting-decision records without promising cultivar authenticity or viability

monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral seed-storage container comparison with eight checkout gates, total-system cost, a valid buy-nothing outcome, and contextual paths to existing inventory and lockbox guides. No merchant, model, live price, stock, discount, rating, test, or product image was added.

image_qa.note: The new guide and hub changes use text, tables, checklists, and existing interface assets. No seed, cultivar, container, merchant, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed; this avoids implying that a generic seed photo authenticates genetics or condition.

search_console.decision: The October 12–November 8 report is three days old and valid: 815 impressions, three clicks, 0.368% CTR, and average position 24.093. Arkansas was the only page-level signal with more than a token sample inside positions 4–20 and was materially reinforced on November 12. The two-impression 510-versus-disposable row already maps to a complete existing page; Delaware had two impressions, Blue Dream was near position 48, and remaining rows were single-impression noise. Those signals were deliberately ignored as already addressed, duplicative, too small, or out of range. No item is labeled Data-led; the report prevented cannibalization and repeat work.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy seed-storage and inventory record grounded in current New York OCM rules plus University of Minnesota, Penn State, and Minnesota Department of Agriculture guidance. The system map, eight-gate container screen, receipt-to-planting record, condition-response matrix, and reciprocal links strengthen the lawful starter-material, home-grow planning, inventory, and access-control cluster. One qualified New York OCM public-information opportunity was logged; no outreach was sent.

seed-source, home-grow planning, inventory, lockbox, guide-hub, and gear-hub contextual paths
